findings: The exact existing-owner delta authorized by the 1200 plan is now implemented in OperatorOverlayService rather than preserved only as a proposal.
Mutation class follows the mutation that actually occurred: structural rebuild and drift fallback mark focus destruction possible; successful in-place refresh does not receive rebuild amnesty.

After layout, the existing overlay root supplies overlay-wide direct keyboard-focus presence separately from the heartbeat-child semantic focus id and calls the explicit seven-argument captured-owner revalidation.
The implementation does not query or claim TalkBack accessibility focus; root.findFocus() is direct keyboard-focus evidence only.
No second overlay owner, renderer, focus tracker, transport, phone path, or P0 coordinator was introduced.
Repository skill doctrine and applied-delta provenance were synchronized so stale OWNER WIRING NO language no longer contradicts the source.

The viewport skill also repaired a doctrine contradiction by separating the older semantic-only selected-first helper from the stronger geometry-aware captured-owner contract now consumed by the service.
The existing warm-wall SVG was mutated in place to reflect source wiring while explicitly withholding runtime/TalkBack/phone claims.
